intentAndPurpose.intent: Floating label that attaches to a trigger element. The canonical API follows Figma: position, tip, disable, delay, hideDelay, offset, and portal; deprecated Base UI-style aliases remain compatible.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger element the tooltip attaches to

props.name: content
props.description: Text or content displayed inside the tooltip

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment along the side axis

props.name: arrow
props.description: Whether to show the arrow/tip pointing to the trigger.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Delay before hiding (ms).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Default open state (uncontrolled)

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay before showing (ms).

props.name: disable
props.description: Whether the tooltip is disabled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether tooltip is disabled.

props.name: hideDelay
props.description: Delay before the tooltip disappears (ms).

props.name: hoverable
props.description: Whether the tooltip contents can be hovered without closing

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width of the tooltip; when set, copy wraps inside that width (default popup is single-line nowrap).

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance between the tooltip and its trigger, in pixels.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the tooltip opens or closes

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the tooltip is open (controlled)

props.name: portal
props.description: Whether the popup is rendered outside its local DOM hierarchy. `true` mounts under `document.body`; `false` mounts beside the trigger and can therefore be clipped by local overflow/transform ancestors.

props.name: position
props.description: Where the tooltip is placed relative to its trigger — `"top"` renders it above the trigger, matching Base UI `side` and the convention used by Floating UI, Radix, MUI, Bootstrap, Ant Design, Chakra, and Carbon. Maps to side+align internally. If both `position` and `side` are provided, `side`/`align` take precedence.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger to position against

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance from the trigger in pixels.

props.name: subtle
props.description: Force subtle motion (Motion Foundations a11y level): faster Subtle durations/easings and opacity-only animation — no transform/translate. Use this to preview reduced motion without changing OS settings. `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` triggers the same path automatically.

props.name: tip
props.description: Whether to show the Figma tip pointing to the trigger.

props.name: trigger
props.description: How the tooltip is triggered.

props.name: zIndex
props.description: Custom z-index for the tooltip

codeSnippets.title: Basic Usage
codeSnippets.code:
import { Button, Tooltip } from '@oneui/ui';

<Tooltip content="More information">
  <Button>Details</Button>
</Tooltip>

interactionBehavior.summary: A non-modal floating label. Default `trigger="hover"` waits 200ms before opening (a pass-through under 200ms never shows it) and, with `hoverable` default true, stays open if the pointer moves onto the bubble. `trigger="click"` and `trigger="focus"` open with zero delay. Not focus-trapped, no scroll lock, no inert page. `disable` / `disabled` prevent every trigger mode from opening. Children are wrapped in a `<span>` so Base UI events still attach when the child (for example Button) does not spread DOM props. On open the popup fades and slides in from a 5px per-side offset (top eases from `translateY(5px)`, bottom from `-5px`, left/right the equivalent on X) while the arrow translates from its retracted `--tip-translate` to `0 0` in sync — open runs `--Motion-Duration-M` / `--Motion-Easing-Entrance-Moderate`, close swaps the timing to `--Motion-Easing-Exit-Moderate`. Subtle/reduced-motion (and `data-instant` inside a provider delay group) collapse this to an opacity-only fade with the transform and arrow held at 0.
hover: Default `trigger="hover"`: the tooltip opens after `delay` (200ms, overriding Base UI's 600ms). A cursor that leaves before that elapses never opens it.
`hideDelay` (alias `closeDelay`) delays hide on unhover; when omitted, hide timing is Base UI's default.
`hoverable` default true (`disableHoverablePopup={!hoverable}`) lets the pointer travel onto the popup without closing. Set `hoverable={false}` to close as soon as the pointer leaves the trigger.
The trigger wrapper is visually inert (`cursor: inherit`, no fill). Hover feedback lives on the child, not the tooltip.

Inside a `TooltipProvider` delay group, sliding the pointer from one trigger to an adjacent one opens the next tooltip with no delay and no entrance transition: Base UI sets `data-instant` on the popup (when it opens during the group's instant phase, or closes because a sibling opened) and OneUI answers with `transition: none`. A standalone tooltip with no provider never receives `data-instant`, so it always plays its normal transition.
press: `trigger="click"` toggles on the trigger press, with `delay={0}` / `closeDelay={0}` so it does not wait for the hover timer.
A pointer-down outside the trigger or portalled popup closes click and focus tooltips. `trigger="manual"` does not add that outside-press listener.
Hover-mode outside-press is left to Base UI (unhover / dismiss), not the extra document listener.
focus: `trigger="focus"` opens on focus and closes on blur. OneUI calls `preventBaseUIHandler` so Base UI's internal focus open never runs — OneUI's own focus/blur handlers own the state.
Hover mode still opens from keyboard focus via Base UI's native tooltip focus behaviour — OneUI does not add a second listener there.
The tooltip is not a focus trap. Focus stays on the trigger; the popup is `role="tooltip"` while open.
While closed but `keepMounted`, the retained node is `role="presentation"` and `aria-hidden`, so it is not announced.
keyboard: `Escape` closes click, focus, and manual tooltips via a document `keydown` listener (WCAG dismiss-on-request). Hover mode uses Base UI `useDismiss` instead of that extra listener.
There is no Tab trap. `Tab` from a `trigger="focus"` tooltip blurs the trigger and closes it.

Click/focus/manual cancel Base UI `trigger-hover` / `trigger-focus` / `trigger-press` open events so those reasons cannot open the tooltip behind the OneUI handlers. `escape-key` and `outside-press` are allowed through.
disabled: `disable` (canonical) or deprecated `disabled` is passed to Base UI as `disabled`. Hover, click, and focus all refuse to open.
When both aliases are passed with different values, `disable` wins.
touch: Hover-open is mouse-only (`mouseOnly` on Base UI's hover interaction). A finger tap does not start the 200ms hover timer.
A tap that focuses the trigger can still open the default tooltip through Base UI's focus path. Use `trigger="click"` when the open affordance must be an explicit tap/toggle.
